organizeNoteId.label: Organize Note
organizeNoteId.description: The note that displays the Organize triage UI. Selecting it converts that note into a render note pointing at the Organize page; clearing it reverts the previously-chosen note to a text note.

morningTime.label: Morning
morningTime.description: The time the Organize "Morning" button sets on a task's start date.

noonTime.label: Noon
noonTime.description: The time the Organize "Noon" button sets.

eveningTime.label: Evening
eveningTime.description: The time the Organize "Evening" button sets.

nightTime.label: Night
nightTime.description: The time the Organize "Night" button sets.

excludeFilters.label: Exclude Filters
excludeFilters.description: Notes matching any enabled filter's search query are skipped by every triage queue on the Organize page. The misfiled-notes queue and the Invalid Roots table still report them: those are about the notebook being wrong, not about work you have chosen not to triage.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Trilium search syntax (same as the search bar), e.g. #archived or note.type = code.
